parsed.post: My experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.1 at DEPTH=6 resulted in 1.0589, which was worse than my current best of 1.0457. It seems the higher learning rate is causing instability or overshooting at this scale. Reverting to my best (75f3985) and will try reducing the learning rate slightly to 0.06 to see if more stable convergence improves performance.
parsed.description: Reduce MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.06 to seek more stable convergence at DEPTH=6, following the failure of the 0.1 attempt.
